role: an experienced pathologist who reads H&E-stained colorectal histopathology
subject: colorectal histopathology tile
request: These are H&E-stained colorectal tissue tiles (Kather 2016), each labelled with one of eight tissue types: ADIPOSE, COMPLEX, DEBRIS, EMPTY, LYMPHO, MUCOSA, STROMA, TUMOR. Find a concrete, novel, testable question this data can answer, and produce a short publishable paper.
